display_name: Boolean-safe structural oak joinery and clean cut faces
intent: The canonical clean joinery extension for structural_oak_timber_v1. It preserves the shared white-oak growth volume across mortises, housings, tenons, shoulders, and peg bores while assigning every generated face an explicit corner-domain semantic class. It adds no damage, repair, grime, or roughness texture.

rules: Only manifold operands are guaranteed to produce proper Boolean results.
The Exact solver is the robust choice for coplanar or overlapping input.
Transfer material mode carries source materials onto generated faces and adds slots when needed.

timber_joint.publisher: Timber Framers Guild forum and Timber Frame HQ
rules: A common square-rule tenon thickness is one quarter of the timber thickness.
A common peg diameter is one half of the tenon thickness.
A fully housed mortise-and-tenon adds a shallow bearing housing around the deeper mortise.
Typical housing depth is three quarters to one and one half inches, subject to engineering.
The tenon hole is offset toward the shoulder so driving the peg draws the joint home.
Reported traditional draw is normally no less than one sixteenth inch and no more than one eighth inch.
Traditional pegs are commonly riven, roughly octagonal, and tapered at the entering point.

white_oak_anatomy.paper: Seasonal Cambial Activity and Formation of Secondary Phloem and Xylem in White Oaks
white_oak_anatomy.rule: Reuse the measured ring-porous anatomy, 64-ring champion, 832-ring compiled table, pith path, rays, and vessel scales owned by structural_oak_timber_v1.

semantic_surface_classes.meaning: Deep bearing floor at the bottom of the mortise.

semantic_surface_classes.name: housing_wall
semantic_surface_classes.meaning: Shallow perimeter wall of the fully housed seat.

semantic_surface_classes.meaning: Shallow load-bearing seat surrounding the mortise.

semantic_surface_classes.name: peg_bore

semantic_surface_classes.name: peg_end
semantic_surface_classes.meaning: Transverse peg end and tapered entering point.

coordinate_contract.material_boundary: Boolean cutter material transfer identifies new faces; the marker is converted immediately into an explicit surface class and atlas UV before the next Boolean.
coordinate_contract.continuity_rule: Each atlas tile evaluates the same pith controls and ring table as structural_oak_timber_v1 at the physical X/Y/Z coordinates of the cut. No cut face invents a replacement grain frequency.
coordinate_contract.interpolation_rule: Every polygon corner receives the same integer surface class. No point-domain or triangle-interpolated mask decides cut identity.
coordinate_contract.resize_rule: Joint dimensions and atlas parameterization are expressed in metres. Resizing a stock member requires recompiling the joint specification, not scaling pore or ring anatomy.
